Both cannot be simultaneously satisfied. Producer correctly reports outcome MIXED due to this internal contradiction. Measurement validity deviation: spec measurement_validity #5 states Transfer-Encoding: chunked applied by proxy in all modes (constant background, same as parent). run_experiment.py and result.json validity_notes state both configs use PASSTHROUGH forwarding with Content-Length (isolate cache key effect) and report.md explicitly says Proxy uses Content-Length forwarding (not chunked TE). No Transfer-Encoding header is ever set in run_experiment.py. Claim about surviving chunked TE is therefore not tested in this experiment; validity_notes correctly disclose Content-Length forwarding but spec/measurement_validity must be corrected and claim_ceiling must not include chunked-TE survival beyond parent EXP-RUNTIME-35330741639 constant-background evidence.

Determinism-across-paths verification deviates from spec: spec decision_rule (2) requires decompressed hash through auth-aware CACHED matches parent direct-server hash; PARENT_REF_HASHES dict is defined but never used for verification. run_experiment.py:857-937 implements live direct-server comparison (starts fresh MockOAuthHandler on port 6100+ and decompresses direct response) for 36 AUTH-AWARE checks, not frozen parent hash comparison. Also NAIVE excluded by design (correct, would fail) but spec says for each (auth_state, content_type, size) without excluding NAIVE. Report and result must clarify that verification is live-proxy-vs-live-direct, not frozen-parent-hash, and that parent hash constant is unused; future verdict should cite live comparison as evidence, not parent artifact.

C_PASSTHROUGH_REGRESSION control as defined in spec (PASSTHROUGH discrimination =0.5) is not directly tested: experiment has only two cache configs NAIVE and AUTH-AWARE, no separate PASSTHROUGH proxy_behavior. Producer maps C_PASSTHROUGH_REGRESSION to C_NAIVE_CACHED_REPRODUCTION (NAIVE=0.0) and infers infrastructure stability via C_AUTH_AWARE_PRIMARY, but spec condition mentions PASSTHROUGH discrimination =0.5. DIRECTOR must map regression correctly: NAIVE=0.0 reproduces parent CACHED falsification, AUTH-AWARE=0.5 matches parent PASSTHROUGH/RECOMPRESS 0.5 baseline; there is no independent non-cached passthrough mode in this run.

validity_findings.finding: Frozen spec decision_rule is internally contradictory: SURVIVES condition (1) decompressed >=0.3 for ALL (auth_state, cache_config) cells includes NAIVE, while condition (4) requires NAIVE=0.0 to reproduce parent. Minimum decompressed discrimination across all 18 cells is 0.0 (NAIVE), so condition (1) fails whenever condition (4) passes. Producer result.json correctly reports min 0.0 across all cells and auth-aware min 0.5; provenance and report acknowledge contradiction and emit outcome MIXED (c1 false, c4 true). This is a DESIGN flaw, not measurement failure. Recomputed c1 min 0.0, c4 pass true, c6 auth-aware min 0.5 true, confirming MIXED is the correct logical response to contradictory spec. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST as written is unsatisfiable.

claim_ceiling: Iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity loop max_depth=5) maintains decompression-normalized discrimination at 0.5 (threshold >=0.3) ONLY when the localhost Python reverse proxy cache key includes Authorization (URL, Accept-Encoding, Authorization) and origin sets Cache-Control: private, Vary: Authorization — across JSON/HTML/XML x 1KB/10KB/100KB (9 conditions) x 4 auth states (no_auth, valid_token, expired_token, invalid_token with 3-way error collapse) x 5 reps (180 requests per cache_config, 360 total, seed 44, jitter 50-150ms). Verified: 0 decompression errors, within-state decompressed hash all_same=true per state, B-RANDOM 0.0, proxy byte-preserving (36 live direct vs proxy checks, 0 mismatches, Content-Length forwarding). Bounded to: single-layer brotli origin quality 6, localhost mock on dynamic ports, Content-Length forwarding (NOT chunked TE), synthetic padded bodies, HS256 locally signed tokens, no real CDN (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai), no double/triple-brotli through proxy, no binary content, no edge quality diversity, no Accept-Encoding negotiation across nodes, no production-scale concurrency/latency. Parent CACHED falsification with naive (URL, Accept-Encoding) key (discrimination 0.0) reproduced exactly and is bounded as CDN cache-key semantics, NOT decompression failure. Real CDN with auth-aware configuration remains untested and is still the sole blocker for C-MEAS-VALID product readiness.
